## Duke Music Day

A full day of live music on campus. Former students from almost every course JZ has taught will be performing at some point.

- Friday September 18: all day, everywhere;
- **Website**: <https://www.dukemusiccollective.com/duke-music-day/>;
- **Insta**: [@dukemusiccollective](https://www.instagram.com/dukemusiccollective/).
